data.long_meaning: In Greek, Xiomaris means 'God's gracious gift'. It is derived from the Greek words 'xenos' meaning 'stranger' or 'guest' and 'marios' meaning 'rejoice' or 'grace'. The name is also associated with the Greek goddess Xenia, who was the goddess of hospitality and guest-friendship. The name Xiomaris carries the meaning “God's Gracious Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Xiomaris usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gracious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
